blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Mandaue City Fire Station is intensifying public safety awareness efforts and inspecting cemeteries ahead of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day as part of Oplan Kaluluwa. Senior Fire Officer 4 Noel Codilla, public information officer of the Mandaue City Fire Station, said the bureau has been conducting public safety awareness campaigns in various areas to remind residents of fire prevention measures. The public is advised not to leave candles and other ignition sources unattended at home, particularly when leaving to visit cemeteries.
